question: Which prime meridian do the Gazetteer Vesta centre points use?
terrain: source/science/vesta-hamo-dtm-64.pds.zip (Vesta_HAMO_dtm_global_64.pds: planetocentric radius in metres, 64 px/deg, west edge 0 E, Claudia frame), read every 4th sample between 50 S and 50 N
method: Radius at the stated centre compared with the mean radius on a 16-point ring one crater diameter away; a crater centre should be lower.
conclusion: The Gazetteer uses Claudia Double Prime, 210 degrees from the Claudia frame of the maps and mesh, as the GRaND catalogue states. The surface map left edge (Claudia 0 E) is therefore 150 E in the Gazetteer frame.
